jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, App o11y | UK | Remote
jobs.jd_full:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

What makes you a great fit:

  • A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management
  • 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product
  • Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers
  • A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top
  • Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, application instrumentation, SDKs, and telemetry collectors
  • Experience with distributed tracing or continuous profiling systems, such as Grafana Tempo or Grafana Pyroscope
  • Experience with eBPF and/or automatic instrumentation
  • Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies
  • Experience defining or evolving pricing and packaging for consumption-based or product-led SaaS offerings
  • Experience operating applications in production, being on call, or troubleshooting performance and reliability issues

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 94,508 - 113,410. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

jobs.jd_full:
About the Team

The Transformation team at OpenAI partners with Finance, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering to design and scale the business processes and systems that support our growth. Our work combines process design, systems thinking, and operational change to turn fragmented workflows into reliable, repeatable, and well-controlled operations.

We work as embedded partners to Finance, Accounting, and Operations, shaping priorities and delivering improvements across core business processes. For compute, our focus is an accurate, connected view of contractual obligations, delivered capacity, usage, and cost that supports sound decisions and repeatable financial operations.

About the Role

As Program Manager, Compute Transformation, you will lead cross-functional initiatives that connect purchasing, operations, billing, accounting, and financial planning across our compute commitments and our data center initiatives. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of problem definition, process design, integrated planning, and end-to-end delivery.

You will work across Compute Finance, Infrastructure Accounting, Capacity Planning, Fleet, Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Data, and Engineering. You will turn ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, drive decisions and dependencies, and deliver reliable processes and systems that make compute and infra spend easier to understand, forecast, reconcile, and control.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with a hybrid work model of 3 days per week in the office.

In this role, you will:

  • Own an integrated compute and infra transformation plan: workstreams, milestones, critical dependencies, resources, decision logs, and acceptance criteria. Drive execution from problem definition through production adoption.
  • Map current workflows and design scalable processes from demand planning, contracting, delivery & acceptance, receiving & operations, invoicing, payment, and month-end close. Clarify ownership, handoffs, evidence, and exception paths.
  • Enable source of truth systems that cover both operational needs and accounting / finance needs for data center construction, operations, and maintenance.
  • Drive consistent tracking of contracts, tranches, delivery events, and capacity acceptance. Connect committed spend to provisioned, accepted, allocated, and used capacity to support forecasting and financial review.
  • Coordinate reliable ingestion and normalization of cloud service provider usage, billing, invoice, and delivery data. Establish data owners, completeness checks, and traceability to financial outputs.
  • Improve compute billing, accrual, and allocation processes through consistent pricing rules, SKU mappings, telemetry and organizational tags, reconciliations, and controlled handling of manual adjustments.
  • Partner with application, AI, and data engineers to translate requirements into integrations and automation across contract, procurement, compute data, and finance platforms, with monitoring and governed change controls.
  • Align Infrastructure, Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Legal, and Engineering on decisions and dependencies. Manage scope, risks, vendor dependencies, and change requests; escalate with clear options and business impact.
  • Lead end-to-end testing, UAT, rollout, training, and handoff to operational owners. Define success measures for traceability, data quality, manual effort, exception resolution, close readiness, and adoption.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • 8+ years of experience in project or program management, finance transformation, infrastructure operations, or enterprise systems delivery in complex, scaled environments.
  • Understanding of compute or infrastructure economics and related finance processes, including commitments, usage-based billing, procurement, accruals, cost allocation, and forecasting.
  • Experience partnering with software and data engineers to define requirements, resolve tradeoffs, test solutions, and deliver changes into production without direct authority.
  • A strong process mindset and the ability to connect contractual terms, operational events, financial data, and control requirements into a practical future-state design.
  • Fluency in data dependencies, system integrations, reconciliation, and data quality. Comfort working with analytical teams and tools such as SQL, Databricks, and BI platforms.
  • Experience improving workflows through automation or AI, with appropriate human review, controls, exception handling, and operational ownership.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive updates that explain decisions, risks, business impact, and specific actions needed.

The Senior Project Manager plans, directs, coordinates, and delivers activities for designated clinical study projects to ensure that project objectives of quality, scope, cost, and time are accomplished.  

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:   

  • Serve as primary point-of-contact and primary escalation point to the client
  • Coordinate and oversees all functional services including external vendors to the established timeline and budget
  • Manage the study budget, ensuring project remains within scope and that any out of scope activities are identified early and handled as appropriate. Independently drive the CO to completion and execution with support as needed.
  • Maintain integrated collaboration with clinical operations in the delivery and participates in clinical activities as appropriate. For projects of very limited scope (i.e. number of sites), Sr. PM may assume all clinical activities
  • Manage the financial health of assigned studies, including oversight of the project profitability, billable project hours, and compliance with on time, accurate billing and forecasting to support business objectives.
  • Develop robust and comprehensive project plans, including timelines and proactive risk management and mitigation, to guide all parameters of trial execution with consistency and quality
  • Ensure Quality management for assigned projects, including eTMF Inspection readiness, implementation of quality notification incident forms and / or corrective and preventative action plans to address any quality findings.
  • Maintain integrated collaboration with all functional operations in the delivery of the program and review as necessary of other study documentation
  • Establish tracking metrics to monitor trial and team progress towards project goals
  • Prepare project status updates and report on progress to clients and senior management, including reporting on key performance indicators, offering solutions and opportunities as they arise
  • Leads both internal and client meetings and set expectations for the project team
  • Communicate effectively with client and Precision management to relay protocol/study issues including any deviations and implements necessary actions in response to those issues

jobs.title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
jobs.jd_full:
Our mission

We’re making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That’s for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We’re solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don’t always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that’s where you come in…

How you’ll help us achieve it

Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can’t, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn’t take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don’t know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.

AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren’t secure, won’t scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.

We’re looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn’t much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use.

In this role, you’ll…

  • - Own how Wave’s general work tools get used. You’re accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they’re set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you’ve seen first-hand from users.
    • Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.
    • Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.
    • Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You’re the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn’t exist at all.
    • Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you’ll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, or Burkina Faso

  • Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave’s travel policy.

  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d’Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we’ve found this key to understanding our users and product.

  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $142,200 - $203,300 USD, plus a generous equity package.

  • Major benefits:

    • Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirement

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, or in a similar role where you owned products or processes end-to-end, ideally in high-ownership, fast-paced environments like scale-ups.

  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and improving operational workflows that save teams time, produce accurate results, and run reliably at a reasonable cost.

  • AI-fluent: you’ve used tools like Claude or ChatGPT to build skills, automations, or workflows that did something meaningful in your actual job, not just experiments.

  • Speak fluent English

  • Bonus if you

  • Bonus if you

    • Speak at least conversational French
    • Have worked with Slack and an enterprise workflow tool like Monday, Jira or Linear.
    • Have worked in or closely with large operations teams (support, field, finance)
    • Are a mobile money user in Sub-Saharan Africa

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Have a good nose for user-focused product design and obsess over user experience.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.
  • Are excited about travel and meet users where they are — your users will be in Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, and other countries in Africa, and some travel will be essential.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you’ve seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don’t just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you’re excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you’ll feel right at home here.

If that’s you, we’d love to meet you.

 

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We’re deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You’ll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator’s top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Our Story

Launched in 2015, Sol de Janeiro is a globally recognized, award-winning beauty brand, drawing inspiration from Brazil’s beauty rituals, warmth, and spirit. Sol de Janeiro delivers a sensory experience beloved by multi-generational consumers worldwide, with clinically proven results, transformative textures, and transportive fragrances.  

Headquartered in New York and launched as a digitally native brand, we have expanded globally with teams in Paris, London, and Germany. Our commitment to excellence has earned high-profile honors, including being named one of _TIME1_00’s 2024 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s 2024 World’s Most Innovative Companies, and WWD Beauty Inc’s Power Brands of 2024, underscoring its leadership in the beauty industry and outstanding workplace. These accolades highlight our dedication to being a leading brand in the beauty industry and an exceptional workplace. 

What You’ll Do

The Project Manager, Commercialization independently manages a portfolio of product initiatives from project kickoff through Commercialization Readiness. This role converts business priorities into clear project plans, aligned timelines, accountable actions, and executable launch decisions. 

The Project Manager serves as the day-to-day cross-functional leader across Product & Innovation, Marketing, Product Development, Packaging Engineering, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Commercial, and regional market teams. 

This role is accountable for maintaining project momentum, anticipating risks, driving decisions, and ensuring teams remain aligned against key milestones and business commitments. The Project Manager applies consistent governance and operational rigor while adapting to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

This position reports into the Commercialization organization and contributes to stronger, more scalable commercialization practices. 

What You’ll Be Working On

Independent Portfolio Ownership 

  • Independently manage a defined portfolio of commercialization projects from kickoff through Commercialization Readiness.
  • Build, maintain, and communicate integrated cross-functional project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Translate business priorities into clear project plans with defined ownership, timing, and decision requirements.
  • Own the day-to-day project cadence, stakeholder communication, follow-up, and escalation process.
  • Maintain accurate visibility to project status, critical-path activities, open decisions, and readiness.
  • Balance multiple concurrent projects and changing priorities while protecting key business commitments.

Cross-Functional Leadership 

  • Lead recurring project meetings and working sessions that drive alignment, accountability, and timely execution.
  • Coordinate across Marketing, Product Development, Packaging Engineering, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, Commercial, and regional teams.
  • Clarify roles, actions, decisions, and due dates so teams understand what is required to move projects forward.
  • Facilitate productive discussions around project trade-offs, dependencies, timing, and execution options.
  • Document decisions and ensure agreed actions are completed or appropriately escalated.
  • Build strong working relationships and influence results without relying on direct authority.

Proactive Risk Management 

  • Identify project risks, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies early in the commercialization process.
  • Maintain clear risk and decision tracking, including owners, mitigation plans, timing, and business impact.
  • Bring the right stakeholders together to resolve issues before they affect launch timing, production, inventory, cost, regulatory readiness, or commercial commitments.
  • Escalate unresolved risks with clear context, options, recommendations, and required decisions.
  • Monitor changes to scope, timing, cost, or technical requirements and assess downstream impact across the project plan.
  • Maintain transparency so leadership and project teams have an accurate view of project health and priority risks.

Operational Rigor & Commercialization Readiness 

  • Apply commercialization governance, stage-gate requirements, and readiness criteria consistently across assigned projects.

  • Maintain organized project documentation, action logs, decision records, and status reporting.
  • Support a disciplined handoff into operational execution while maintaining communication through launch stabilization.

Continuous Improvement 

  • Identify recurring execution gaps, process inefficiencies, and opportunities to simplify commercialization ways of working.
  • Apply standard tools, templates, reporting, and governance practices across the portfolio.
  • Capture lessons learned and share practical recommendations that improve future project execution.
  • Support improvements to project management tools, stage-gate processes, readiness criteria, and portfolio reporting.
  • Help strengthen transparency, accountability, decision-making, and cross-functional collaboration across commercialization.

Must Haves

  • 5-7 years of experience in commercialization, new product development, project management, program management, product innovation, supply chain, or a related cross-functional role.
  • Experience independently managing multiple concurrent projects within a fast-paced, highly cross-functional organization.
  • Beauty, cosmetics, personal care, consumer products, or related industry experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end product commercialization lifecycle from concept through readiness and launch execution.
  • Experience building and managing integrated project timelines, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.
